使用 GADM Australia 和 WorldClim 历史月均温，练习投影转换、城市提取、栅格裁剪与描述统计。

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = TRUE, echo = TRUE, dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 120)
```

## 数据与包

GADM Australia 存为 `data/raw/week03/gadm41_AUS.gpkg`；WorldClim v2.1 的 12 个 tavg、5 角分 TIFF 存入 `data/raw/week03/worldclim/`。基准期 1970–2000，单位 °C，`5m` 为角分。

```{r packages, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("here", "sf", "terra", "tidyverse", "fs", "tidyterra", "plotly"))
```

## 加载工具

```{r tools}
root <- here::here()
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
```

## 3.5.1 矢量 CRS

读取以 `_0` 结尾的国家层。4326 为经纬度，3112 为澳大利亚米制 Lambert 投影。

```{r vector-crs}
aus_file <- file.path(root, "data/raw/week03/gadm41_AUS.gpkg")
layers <- st_layers(aus_file)
layers
aus_layer <- layers$name[grepl("_0$", layers$name)]
stopifnot(length(aus_layer) == 1)
Ausoutline <- st_read(aus_file, layer = aus_layer, quiet = TRUE)
print(Ausoutline)
st_crs(Ausoutline)
st_crs(Ausoutline)$proj4string
plot(st_geometry(Ausoutline))
```

## 转换坐标

`st_transform()` 计算新坐标；`st_set_crs()` 仅设置标签，缺失 CRS 需查元数据。

```{r transform-vector}
stopifnot(!is.na(st_crs(Ausoutline)))
AusoutlinePROJECTED <- st_transform(Ausoutline, 3112)
st_bbox(Ausoutline)
st_bbox(AusoutlinePROJECTED)
plot(st_geometry(AusoutlinePROJECTED))

AusoutlineSP <- as(Ausoutline, "Spatial")
AusoutlineSF <- st_as_sf(AusoutlineSP)
```

## 3.5.2 读取一月栅格

检查层、范围、分辨率和 CRS。

```{r january}
jan_file <- file.path(root, "data/raw/week03/worldclim/wc2.1_5m_tavg_01.tif")
jan <- terra::rast(jan_file)
jan
terra::res(jan)
terra::crs(jan)
plot(jan)
```

## 栅格投影演示

连续温度使用双线性重采样；投回原坐标也不会恢复全部原值。后续保留原始栅格分析。

```{r raster-reprojection}
moll <- "+proj=moll +lon_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
pr1 <- terra::project(jan, moll, method = "bilinear")
plot(pr1)
pr_back <- terra::project(pr1, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
plot(pr_back)
```

## 3.5.3 十二个月图层

只匹配 tavg、5 角分的 12 个月文件，按月份顺序命名 Jan–Dec。

```{r monthly-stack}
file_info <- fs::dir_info(dirname(jan_file))
listfiles <- file_info %>%
  filter(str_detect(basename(path), "^wc2\\.1_5m_tavg_[0-9]{2}\\.tif$")) %>%
  arrange(path) %>% dplyr::select(path) %>% pull()
stopifnot(length(listfiles) == 12)
worldclimtemp <- terra::rast(as.character(listfiles))
stopifnot(terra::nlyr(worldclimtemp) == 12)
names(worldclimtemp) <- month.abb
worldclimtemp[[1]]
worldclimtemp$Jan
```

## 3.5.4 城市提取

课堂 15 点按已知 CRS 转换后提取格值；Broome 纬度修正为 −17.96。格值不是城市行政区平均，海岸 NA 需核查。

```{r city-extraction}
samples <- tibble(
  Site = c("Brisbane", "Melbourne", "Perth", "Sydney", "Broome", "Darwin", "Orange",
           "Bunbury", "Cairns", "Adelaide", "Gold Coast", "Canberra", "Newcastle", "Wollongong", "Logan City"),
  lon = c(153.03,144.96,115.86,151.21,122.23,130.84,149.10,115.64,145.77,138.6,153.43,149.13,151.78,150.89,153.12),
  lat = c(-27.47,-37.91,-31.95,-33.87,-17.96,-12.46,-33.28,-33.33,-16.92,-34.93,-28,-35.28,-32.93,-34.42,-27.64))
city_sf <- st_as_sf(samples, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
city_sf <- st_transform(city_sf, terra::crs(worldclimtemp))
AUcitytemp <- terra::extract(worldclimtemp, terra::vect(city_sf))
stopifnot(nrow(AUcitytemp) == nrow(samples))
Aucitytemp2 <- bind_cols(samples %>% dplyr::select(Site), as_tibble(AUcitytemp) %>% dplyr::select(-ID))
Aucitytemp2
```

## 3.6 Perth 直方图

只选择月份温度列，频数单位为月份；breaks、counts、mids、density 分别为分箱、频数、中心和密度。

```{r perth-histogram}
Perthtemp <- Aucitytemp2 %>% filter(Site == "Perth")
stopifnot(nrow(Perthtemp) == 1)
perth_values <- Perthtemp %>% dplyr::select(all_of(month.abb)) %>% unlist(use.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(length(perth_values) == 12, is.numeric(perth_values))
hist(perth_values, col = "red", main = "Perth monthly climate normals", xlab = "Temperature (°C)")
userbreak <- seq(floor(min(perth_values, na.rm = TRUE) / 2) * 2,
                 ceiling(max(perth_values, na.rm = TRUE) / 2) * 2 + 2, by = 2)
histinfo <- hist(perth_values, breaks = userbreak, plot = FALSE)
histinfo$breaks
histinfo$counts
histinfo$mids
histinfo$density
plot(histinfo, col = "red")
```

## 全国裁剪与遮罩

`crop` 缩小矩形范围，`mask` 去掉国家边界外格子；简化边界仅用于显示。此处直方图频数单位为格子。

```{r crop-mask}
plot(st_geometry(AusoutlinePROJECTED))
AusoutSIMPLE <- st_simplify(AusoutlinePROJECTED, dTolerance = 1000, preserveTopology = TRUE)
plot(st_geometry(AusoutSIMPLE))
aus_for_raster <- st_transform(Ausoutline, terra::crs(worldclimtemp))
Austemp <- terra::crop(worldclimtemp, terra::vect(aus_for_raster))
exactAus <- terra::mask(Austemp, terra::vect(aus_for_raster))
plot(exactAus$Mar)
hist(exactAus$Mar, col = "red", main = "Australia: March grid-cell temperatures")
```

## 长表、分面与统计

`Month` 为月份，`Temp` 为温度；统计为格子等权，未按面积、人口或月份天数加权。

```{r dataframe-and-histogram}
exactAusdf <- as.data.frame(exactAus, na.rm = FALSE)
ggplot(exactAusdf, aes(x = Mar)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, color = "black", fill = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(exactAusdf$Mar, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Grid-cell frequency")
squishdata <- exactAusdf %>% pivot_longer(all_of(month.abb), names_to = "Month", values_to = "Temp")
twomonths <- squishdata %>% filter(Month %in% c("Jan", "Jun")) %>% drop_na(Temp)
meantwomonths <- twomonths %>% group_by(Month) %>% summarise(mean = mean(Temp), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(twomonths, aes(Temp, fill = Month, color = Month)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, binwidth = 2) +
  geom_vline(data = meantwomonths, aes(xintercept = mean, color = Month), linetype = "dashed")
data_complete_cases <- squishdata %>% drop_na(Temp) %>% mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month.abb))
ggplot(data_complete_cases, aes(Temp)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 5) + facet_grid(Month ~ .)
monthly_stats <- data_complete_cases %>% group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(Temp), sd = sd(Temp), min = min(Temp), max = max(Temp), IQR = IQR(Temp), .groups = "drop")
monthly_stats
data_complete_cases %>% summarise(meanwholeyear = mean(Temp))
```

## 扩展：栅格图与交互直方图

使用 tidyterra 与 plotly，比较一月和六月的格网温度分布。

```{r optional-interactive-and-raster-ggplot, eval=FALSE}
ggplot() + tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = exactAus, aes(fill = Mar))
jan_values <- filter(data_complete_cases, Month == "Jan")$Temp
jun_values <- filter(data_complete_cases, Month == "Jun")$Temp
plotly::plot_ly(alpha = 0.6) %>%
  plotly::add_histogram(x = jan_values, name = "January", xbins = list(size = 2.5)) %>%
  plotly::add_histogram(x = jun_values, name = "June", xbins = list(size = 2.5)) %>%
  plotly::layout(barmode = "overlay", xaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)"), yaxis = list(title = "Grid-cell frequency"))
```
